serious.description: Ensure every ARIA input field has an accessible name
Ensure every ARIA progressbar node has an accessible name
Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
Ensure links have discernible text
Link text "MK" is an abbreviation and does not clearly describe its purpose or destination (likely a language switch to Macedonian). When read out of context, it is not understandable.
Link text "AL" is an abbreviation and does not clearly describe its purpose or destination (likely a language switch to Albanian). When read out of context, it is not understandable.
Link text "EN" is an abbreviation and does not clearly describe its purpose or destination (likely a language switch to English). When read out of context, it is not understandable.
Link text "Мени" (Menu) is misleading as it links to the homepage (`pocetna.nspx`) instead of a menu or sitemap. This creates confusion about the link's purpose.
serious.suggestion: If it's a home link: "Почетна" or "Насловна". If it's a menu toggle, it should be a button. If it links to a menu page, "Sitemap" or "Full Menu".

serious.description: The link text "Набавки" (Procurements) is too general and not sufficiently distinct from "Јавни набавки" (Public Procurements) when both are present, making it difficult for users to differentiate their destinations without additional context.
serious.suggestion: Specify the type of procurements, e.g., "Општи набавки" (General Procurements) or "Внатрешни набавки" (Internal Procurements), or clarify its scope relative to "Јавни набавки".

serious.description: The link text "ИНФО" (INFO) is too vague and does not clearly communicate the specific destination or purpose of the link when read out of context.
serious.suggestion: Specify the type of information, e.g., "Контакт информации" (Contact Information), "Општи информации" (General Information), "За нас" (About Us), or "Вести и ажурирања" (News and Updates).

serious.description: Link text is misleading as it implies general active employment measures, but the link destination is specifically for announcements for employers. The line breaks in the text are also not ideal.
serious.suggestion: ОГЛАСИ ЗА РАБОТОДАВАЧИ (Announcements for Employers) or АКТИВНИ МЕРКИ ЗА ВРАБОТУВАЊЕ ЗА РАБОТОДАВАЧИ (Active Employment Measures for Employers)

serious.description: Link text suggests a page or list of 'Announcements for Active Measures', but the link is an anchor to a section named '#profile' on the current page. This mismatch is confusing and misleading.
serious.suggestion: Скокни до активни мерки (Jump to Active Measures) or Преглед на активни мерки (Overview of Active Measures)

serious.description: Generic link text 'ДОЗНАЈ ПОВЕЌЕ' (Learn More) does not describe the link's purpose or destination when read out of context.

issues: Multiple h1 elements are used, which breaks the document outline and indicates a lack of a single main topic for the page.
Heading levels are skipped (e.g., h1 followed by h4, h1 followed by h5), creating an illogical hierarchy.
The h5 element is misused to contain a list of links rather than serving as a heading.
Headings at the same level (h1s) do not have comparable importance, treating major sections and specific reports as equally primary.
Several headings are too generic and do not adequately describe the content of their sections.
missingSections: Sub-sections under 'ЗА БАРАТЕЛИТЕ НА РАБОТА' such as 'ВОВЕДУВАЊЕ ВО ЕВИДЕНЦИЈА', 'ПРОГРАМИ ЗА ВРАБОТУВАЊЕ', and 'ПАРИЧЕН НАДОМЕСТОК' could benefit from h3 headings if they represent distinct content areas.
Sub-sections under 'ЗА РАБОТОДАВАЧИТЕ' like 'ПРИКАЗ НА АКТИВНИ БАРАТЕЛИ НА РАБОТА', 'ПРИЈАВУВАЊЕ И ОДЈАВУВАЊЕ НА РАБОТЕН ОДНОС', and 'ПОСРЕДУВАЊЕ ПРИ ВРАБОТУВАЊЕ' may require h3 headings.

positives: Content is primarily presented in clear, concise headings and list items, making it easy to scan and digest.

The language used is direct and avoids overly complex sentence structures, promoting straightforward understanding.
improvements: Consider providing a glossary or brief explanations for domain-specific terms such as 'активни мерки за вработување' to assist users less familiar with employment agency terminology.
items.summary: The content is highly scannable, consisting mainly of navigation and statistical summaries, and uses direct language. It meets the lower-secondary education level requirement for a native Macedonian speaker, making it generally accessible.

evaluation.summary: The Albanian version of this government website exhibits critical accessibility and language quality issues. The HTML lang attribute is incorrectly set to 'en', and a substantial section of the page remains untranslated in Macedonian Cyrillic. The translated Albanian content frequently suffers from poor quality, including numerous calques from Macedonian, typographical errors, and unnatural phrasing.
recommendations: Correct the HTML 'lang' attribute to 'sq' for the Albanian version of the page to ensure proper language identification for assistive technologies.
Translate all remaining Macedonian content into high-quality standard Albanian to comply with legal requirements and improve accessibility.
Conduct a thorough linguistic review of all Albanian text to identify and correct calques, grammatical errors, and unnatural phrasing, ensuring fluency and adherence to standard literary Albanian.
Implement a quality assurance process to prevent typographical errors and ensure consistent character usage (e.g., Latin 'T' instead of Cyrillic 'Т').
